title: ctenodon lewisianus
intro: Ctenodon lewisianus, commonly known as Lewis's ctenodont, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. The health benefits of Ctenodon lewisianus include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating infections and promoting wound healing. Bioactive constituents present in Ctenodon lewisianus include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
